classification.difficultyReason: Read open and filled endpoints and ray directions from number lines, then express each represented set using interval brackets and infinity.

content.prompt: Convert each of the following to interval notation.

spec.description: Filled endpoint at −2 with a blue ray extending right, above a two-ended black number line. TikZ is required because the number-line template does not express a highlighted set segment or ray.
spec.mathematics: All real numbers greater than or equal to −2.
spec.answerVisibility: Given number-line set remains visible in both answer modes.

answer.worked: The filled endpoint includes $-2$, and the arrow represents all larger values. Use a square bracket at $-2$ and a parenthesis at infinity: $[-2,\infty)$.

spec.description: Blue segment with an open endpoint at −3 and a filled endpoint at 1, above a two-ended black number line. The template cannot express the highlighted interval segment.
spec.answerVisibility: Given number-line set remains visible in both answer modes.

answer.worked: The open endpoint excludes $-3$, and the filled endpoint includes $1$. Hence the interval is $(-3,1]$.

spec.description: Blue segment with filled endpoints at 2 and 4, above a two-ended black number line. The template cannot express the highlighted interval segment.
spec.answerVisibility: Given number-line set remains visible in both answer modes.

answer.worked: Both filled endpoints are included, so use square brackets at both ends: $[2,4]$.

spec.description: Blue segment with a filled endpoint at −4 and an open endpoint at −2, above a two-ended black number line. The template cannot express the highlighted interval segment.
spec.answerVisibility: Given number-line set remains visible in both answer modes.

answer.worked: The filled endpoint includes $-4$, and the open endpoint excludes $-2$. Hence the interval is $[-4,-2)$.

spec.description: Open endpoint at −3 with a blue ray extending left, above a two-ended black number line. The template cannot express the highlighted set ray.
spec.answerVisibility: Given number-line set remains visible in both answer modes.

answer.worked: The arrow represents all values less than $-3$, and the open endpoint excludes $-3$. Infinity also takes a parenthesis, giving $(-\infty,-3)$.

spec.description: Blue segment with open endpoints at −2 and 0, above a two-ended black number line. The template cannot express the highlighted interval segment.
spec.answerVisibility: Given number-line set remains visible in both answer modes.

answer.worked: Both open endpoints are excluded, so use parentheses at both ends: $(-2,0)$.
